id.description: The unique identifier of the webhook.

url.description: The URL that receives webhook POST requests.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the webhook belongs to.

created_at.description: The date and time the webhook was created.

push_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on push events.

tag_push_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on tag push events.

issues_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on issue events.

confidential_issues_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on confidential issue events.

merge_requests_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on merge request events.

note_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on comment events.

confidential_note_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on confidential comment events.

job_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on job status change events.

pipeline_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on pipeline status change events.

wiki_page_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on wiki page events.

deployment_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on deployment events.

releases_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on release events.

member_events.description: Whether the webhook triggers on group member events.

enable_ssl_verification.description: Whether SSL certificate verification is enabled for the webhook URL.

push_events_branch_filter.description: Branch name or wildcard pattern to filter push events.

branch_filter_strategy.description: The strategy used for filtering branches.

alert_status.description: The current alert status of the webhook based on delivery failures.

disabled_until.description: If set, the webhook is temporarily disabled until this time.
